title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-20

ai_review.summary: Flawless patched soundboard captures a smoking Fall‑73 show with standout Weather Report Suite, China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, and an epic Truckin' > The Other One > Stella sequence.
ai_review.review: This SBD‑patched source delivers crystal‑clear audio that lets the band’s high‑energy performance shine. The first set rolls from the gate with tight classics like “Lay Me Down” and a soaring Weather Report Suite, while the second set builds through a classic Promised Land > Bertha > GSET flow into a monster Truckin' > The Other One > Stella marathon. Reviewers uniformly praise both the immaculate sound and the inspired playing.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are 5‑star, highlighting flawless recording quality and an exceptional musical performance; the consistent praise yields a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Patched SBD is described as crisp, flawless and well‑balanced; patches fix missing sections without introducing audible glitches, delivering a clean, listenable mix.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon 15‑song first set (~1:45) flows smoothly into a near‑2‑hour second set, with strong segues and sustained energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His tone is called perfect; his playing is tight and he even steals the spotlight on the Truckin' > The Other One marathon.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for brilliant rhythm fills on “Brown Eyed Girl” and described as a guitar wizard throughout the show.
